gw_trace.dns.no_v4: the domain has no IPv4 addresses
gw_trace.dns.timeout: DNS did not answer within {sec} s
gw_trace.err.empty: Enter a domain or an IPv4 address, for example youtube.com or 8.8.8.8.
gw_trace.err.inbound_missing: Device “{device}” has no {inbound} protocol — it has: {have}.
gw_trace.err.inbound_new: A protocol is chosen for a device, and a new device has no protocols yet.
gw_trace.err.inbound_off: The {inbound} protocol of device “{device}” is off or not installed — no traffic goes through it.
gw_trace.err.ipv6: The gateway does not carry IPv6 — enter a domain or an IPv4 address.
gw_trace.err.no_who: No device or user “{ref}” (or the name is ambiguous — give the id d-… or u-…).
gw_trace.err.not_target: “{value}” is neither a domain nor an IPv4 address. Examples: youtube.com, ya.ru, 8.8.8.8.
gw_trace.err.too_long: The text is too long — enter a domain or an IPv4 address.
gw_trace.kernel_hint: WireGuard, AmneziaWG, L2TP, IKEv2, OpenVPN and others
gw_trace.match.blocked_now: but the device is blocked now ({why}) — “direct” does not apply
gw_trace.match.note_block: blocked for every device, whatever the profile
gw_trace.match.note_direct: so directly from the server’s address, bypassing the exits
gw_trace.match.note_force: so by the device’s route, even if the address is in Russian networks
gw_trace.match.note_force_group: so through an exit of the group “{group}” by the route of the device, even when the address is in the networks of Russia
gw_trace.match.note_no_domains: but the domain rule does not apply now — the addresses decide
gw_trace.match.note_profile: does not apply with the “{profile}” profile — traffic follows the route
gw_trace.note.block_doh: Domain blocking works when the device asks the gateway DNS for addresses (as in the issued settings); a browser’s own DNS (DoH) bypasses it.
gw_trace.note.gw_off: The gateway is off — there is no traffic now; this shows how it will go once it is on.
gw_trace.note.no_nftset: dnsmasq has no nftset — “direct” and “always through an exit” domains are not counted, only Russian networks are.
gw_trace.note.partly_ru: The domain has different addresses: {ru} of {total} are in Russian networks — connections to them go direct, the rest by the route.
gw_trace.note.ru_unknown: Russian networks in the table: state unknown (after a reboot kaskad-gw-rules-load.timer loads them).
gw_trace.note.vless_ping: Ping (ICMP) does not pass through an xray exit — that is normal: xray carries only TCP and UDP. Sites and apps open; check the connection with a website, not ping.
gw_trace.note.xray_decides: Through {inbound} the gateway’s xray decides by the same lists plus keyword and regexp — the result may differ from kernel protocols (WireGuard, L2TP and others).
gw_trace.note.xray_no_domains: {inbound}: the gateway’s xray has no domains file yet — domain rules do not apply.
gw_trace.note.xray_no_lists: {inbound}: the gateway’s xray has no lists file yet — this domain won’t be blocked through {inbound}.
gw_trace.note.xray_would: Through {inbound} xray would decide for this device (the same lists plus keyword and regexp) — choose {inbound} in “Through” to see its path.
gw_trace.origin.direct: The site opens directly, from the address of this server{server}
gw_trace.origin.exit: The site opens from the address of exit {names}
gw_trace.origin.exit_named: The site opens from the address of exit “{name}”
gw_trace.origin.one_of_exits: The site opens from the address of one of the exits: {names}
gw_trace.origin.one_of_them: The site opens from the address of one of them: {names}
gw_trace.origin.pool: The site opens from the address of one of the pool exits
gw_trace.ru.first_not_ru: {head} — the first address is not in Russian networks
gw_trace.ru.down_since: The exits of the group “{group}” have been down since {since}.
gw_trace.ru.load_unknown: loading Russian networks into the table is not confirmed — if they are not there, it won’t go direct
gw_trace.ru.no_address_note: nothing to check against Russian networks — traffic follows the route
gw_trace.ru.not_loaded: Russian networks are not loaded into the table now — it won’t go direct by IP
gw_trace.ru.xray_no_geoip: the gateway’s xray has no networks file (geoip) yet — it won’t go direct by address
gw_trace.step.any: Now: any live exit of the pool — picked automatically ({names})
gw_trace.step.no_inbound_note: the device has no enabled protocol — no traffic
gw_trace.step.no_lists_note: RoscomVPN lists are not downloaded: no domain blocks or routing rules
gw_trace.step.not_listed_note: not ads, not “always through an exit”, not “direct”
gw_trace.step.now_block_note: failure policy “block”: everything is closed, Russian sites too
gw_trace.step.now_block_ru_note: failure policy “block”: everything is closed except Russian sites — they go directly (“Russian sites direct”)
gw_trace.step.now_direct_note: failure policy “direct”: everything bypasses the exits
gw_trace.step.off: The device or its user is off
gw_trace.step.off_note: no traffic: the gateway passes no packets
gw_trace.step.pool_pick: The gateway picks an exit among the live exits of the pool
gw_trace.step.ru_exit: Russian sites — through the group “{group}”: exit “{name}” — {state}
gw_trace.step.ru_last_block: Russian sites — the group “{group}”: no exit works, the last step — block
gw_trace.step.ru_last_direct: Russian sites — the group “{group}”: no exit works, the last step — directly from the server
gw_trace.step.ru_offline: The server does not reach Russian addresses — waiting for the connection
gw_trace.step.ru_offline_since: The server has not reached Russian addresses since {since} — waiting for the connection
gw_trace.step.ru_offline_note: Until it is back, the group does not switch exits: the devices stay where they were.
gw_trace.step.vless: Now: one of the VLESS exits — picked automatically ({names})
gw_trace.sum.any: Through any live exit of the pool — picked automatically
gw_trace.sum.no_inbound: No traffic: the device has no enabled protocol
gw_trace.sum.ru_last_block: Russian sites are closed: the group “{group}” has no working exit
gw_trace.sum.vless: Through one of the VLESS exits — picked automatically
gw_trace.who.any_inbound: any protocol except SOCKS5 and VLESS ({hint})
gw_trace.who.inbounds_off: its protocols are off — nothing to connect with
gw_trace.who.no_consent: Russia direct is not on: no ⚠RU confirmation — everything goes through an exit for now
gw_trace.who.no_inbounds: no protocols — nothing to connect with
gw_trace.who.no_lists: no RoscomVPN lists yet — everything goes through an exit for now
gw_trace.who.via_other: through the {inbound} protocol (it also has {others} — check the path through it separately)
gw_trace.who.via_others: through the {inbound} protocol (it also has {others} — check the path through them separately)
gw_trace.why.evicted: the exit “{name}” is not fit now — going through another exit of the group “{group}”
gw_trace.why.group_dead: the group “{group}” has no fit exits
gw_trace.why.missing: the chosen exit was removed — going through the group “{group}”; choose another route
gw_trace.why.pinned: pinned to this exit in the group “{group}”
gw_trace.why.pool_dead: no live exits in the pool
gw_trace.why.pool_live: live exits: {n} — the device will stick to one of them
gw_trace.why.xray_any: {inbound}: xray picks the exit among all live exits of the pool
